title: Siege of Varna (1828)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Varna (1828)", at revision 1371322416, opens: "The siege of Varna took place during the Russo-Turkish War, 1828–1829. The Russian troops forced the Turkish garrison of Varna to capitulate after more than two-month siege." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2073130, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1828 siege during the Russo-Turkish War, (1828–29)". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
